notes: Overview: evaluating real-time agent assist to reduce AHT and NPS-impacting errors during peak traffic.
Primary ask: streaming, token-level suggestions (short prompts) with <150ms 95p latency; fast fallbacks when overloaded.
Quote: "We need suggestions that don't interrupt agent flow — immediate, short, and auditable." — VP CX Marisol Ortega
POC targets: support 2k concurrent active seats, 50k sessions/day; maintain SLOs during 10x promotional spikes.
Integration: must call internal CRM tool APIs (tool-calling) and update Zendesk tickets via webhook; require idempotent tool-hooks.
Security: SOC2 evidence required, SSO/SAML, per-request audit logs, KMS for key handling, EU data residency for certain accounts.
Ops notes: concerned about cold-starts and autoscale granularity for sub-1s suggestion delivery; need warm pools or pinned capacity option.
Cost sensitivity: favor model routing to cheaper quantized variants for background summarization, reserve high-performance runtimes for streaming assist.
Competitor state: doing parallel PoC with Ada and an internal serving stack; Redwood shortlisted on latency and fallback strategy demo.
AE note: exec sponsor engaged; legal/procurement timeline depends on security reviews and pen-test results.
